# Compare Two Texts

> Compare Two Texts is a free diff checker for plain text, Word (.docx), text-based PDF, Excel (.xlsx) and CSV files. It shows the differences side by side, lets you edit the result and download it. Comparison runs in the browser: files are not uploaded to a server or sent to an AI service, and no account is needed.

Key facts:

- Free, with no account, no trial, no subscription and no limit on the number of comparisons. There is no paid plan.
- Works on the website and as a Chrome extension (also installable in Microsoft Edge). The extension works offline once installed.
- Supported files: DOCX, text-based PDF, TXT, XLSX, CSV and TSV, up to 2 MB per file and 5,000 spreadsheet rows per file.
- PDF files need selectable text; scanned pages are not read (no OCR). Text and table content is compared, not images or layout.
- Results can be edited in place and downloaded as DOCX, PDF or TXT. For Word documents you can keep the wording from either version, passage by passage.
- Spreadsheets are compared by an ID or SKU column, showing changed cells and missing rows.
- Interface available in 51 languages.
- The website counts visits with Google Analytics, never the content of texts. The extension contains no analytics.

How to use: open https://comparetwotexts.pro/, paste the original text under A and the changed version under B, then select Compare texts.

## Use it

- [Compare two texts online](https://comparetwotexts.pro/): paste two texts or upload two files and see every difference
- [Chrome extension](https://comparetwotexts.pro/extension/): the same tool in the browser toolbar, working offline
- [Chrome Web Store listing](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/kclhfaiampafehfhhlejeeefhdhocfcg)

## File guides

- [Compare two Word documents](https://comparetwotexts.pro/compare-word-documents/): text and table differences in DOCX files, edit and download the result
- [Compare two PDF files](https://comparetwotexts.pro/compare-pdf-files/): text differences in PDFs with selectable text
- [Compare two Excel files](https://comparetwotexts.pro/compare-excel-files/): match rows by ID or SKU, find changed values and missing records
- [Compare two CSV files](https://comparetwotexts.pro/compare-csv-files/): CSV diff by ID with delimiter choice and column mapping

## Details

- [Pricing](https://comparetwotexts.pro/pricing/): what is free and the current limits
- [Privacy](https://comparetwotexts.pro/privacy/): how documents, encrypted local drafts and analytics are handled
- [Help](https://comparetwotexts.pro/support/): supported files, editing, PDF export and troubleshooting

## Optional

- [Word and Google Docs add-ins](https://comparetwotexts.pro/office-addins/): manually installed prototypes for editing a selected passage inside Word or Google Docs
- [Terms of use](https://comparetwotexts.pro/terms/)
